title: The White Line

voice.name: Liam + Laura
voice.direction: Two distinct dry centered character performances: Liam as Jason, Laura as Lucia. Narration voices approved; these character castings are provisional and need performance listening review. No Lara substitution. Calm urgent turns; no overlap or lip-sync claim.
voice.licensing: Planning only; no generated audio. Existing free-plan review assets require release licensing resolution.

pov: two-character external POV: only what Jason and Lucia say or observe
hook: He said stop before the white line. We're on it. Tell me that counts as before.
alternative_hooks: The buyer waved them forward. The road was gone.
A washing chalk line was the only warning they got.
alternative_hook_use: Replace scene 1 and re-time/recount the master before production; do not append.
script: He said stop before the white line. We're on it. Tell me that counts as before. Jason, look where it ends. That's water over there. The line is chalk, and it's washing away. He's waving the cash again. Maybe the road just dips. We could leave the car and walk. That fence post isn't floating toward us. It's moving sideways. There's a current where the road should be. I can't see the edge anymore. Take my sleeve. Forget the case, just tell me where to step. Back toward my voice. One step. Good. The case is gone. Leave it. Keep your eyes on me. He's backing away too. He didn't know. All that money, and neither side could see the missing road. Then we both got a warning in time. Keep the car here. We'll wait for somebody who knows.
plot_mechanism: a boundary warning acquires its true meaning

canon_status.fictional_elements: All events, dialogue, sets, props, circumstances and supporting extras are original non-canon fan fiction; no game footage or official story claims.
